name: The Shops of Huffman
summary: The Shops of Huffman is a modern, locally owned shopping center in rapidly growing Huffman, Texas, conveniently located near Highway 99 and Lake Houston. Featuring a mix of dining, retail, and professional services with high visibility and ample parking, the center is positioned to serve the area's expanding population.
demographics: The Shops of Huffman serves a growing suburban and rural community in northeast Harris County, attracting middle-income families and working professionals from Huffman and surrounding areas near Lake Houston. The trade area is experiencing rapid population growth due to the completion of TX-99 (Grand Parkway), drawing younger families seeking affordable housing and convenient access to Houston. Primary visitors include local residents seeking everyday services, dining options, and professional services, with shopping patterns focused on convenience and community-oriented businesses rather than destination retail.
description: The Shops of Huffman is a locally owned and managed modern commercial center strategically positioned in the rapidly growing Huffman area of Texas, just miles from Highway 99 and the scenic Lake Houston. With the recent completion of TX-99, the area has experienced significant growth and increased traffic, transforming this location into a prime destination for businesses and customers alike. The center features clean, well-maintained spaces designed for modern businesses to thrive, offering high visibility, ample parking, and a welcoming atmosphere. Current tenants include a premier hair salon and spa, Pizza Hut, an Eye Care Center, and an Italian restaurant, with additional spaces available for diverse businesses including coffee shops with convenient drive-thru access, mid-sized restaurants with outdoor seating, doctors' offices, fitness centers, and cell phone retailers. The shopping center's vision is to become one of the best commercial destinations in the area, providing an inviting environment for both established businesses and the growing community they serve.
